media.title: Ninon, ach uśmiechnij się! — Jan Kiepura, listening reference
media.description: Listening reference for “Ninon, ach uśmiechnij się!” sung by Jan Kiepura. The upload states that the recording was made in Berlin for the Polish Odeon and that the song comes from the film Ein Lied für dich, released in Poland as Zdobyć cię muszę.

works.publicNote: Polish-language version, documented by the Odeon disc O. 236842 sung by Jan Kiepura, which names the film by its Polish release title, Zdobyć cię muszę. The disc is undated beyond the catalogue's [post 1930]; the year given here follows the film.
